title: An algebraically closed prime above a given prime
statement: Let k be a field, S a finite type k-algebra, and q a prime of S. There exist a field K algebraically closed over k and a maximal prime qK of K tensor_k S contracting to q.

source.place: Tag 00TT, proof of (2) => (1), construction of K and m; Tag 00RV for differential base change. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00TT.

proof.text: Form the algebraic closure K of the universe-lifted residue field of q. Compose S to the residue field with its embedding in K, and define the k-algebra structure on K by composition.
The tensor universal property gives the map phi from K tensor_k S to K sending lambda tensor s to lambda times f(s). The preimage lambda tensor 1 proves surjectivity, so its kernel is maximal.

A scalar s belongs to the contraction of the kernel precisely when its residue is zero, since the residue-field embedding is injective. The kernel of the residue map is q; extensionality gives the required contraction.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00TT (explicit geometric point construction) and Tag 00RV (differential base change); read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00TT and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00RV on 2026-10-13.

mathlib_searches.query: Taking the algebraic closure of the residue field yields a closed point over any given prime; differential fibre dimensions are invariant under scalar extension
Kahler differential module under extension of scalars is the tensor product, and its dimension at corresponding prime ideals is unchanged

lean.statement:
theorem exists_algClosed_prime_over
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [FiniteType k S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) :
    ∃ (K : Type (max u v)) (_hK : Field K) (_hAk : Algebra k K) (_hCK : IsAlgClosed K)
      (qK : PrimeSpectrum (K ⊗[k] S)),
      qK.asIdeal.IsMaximal ∧
        PrimeSpectrum.comap
          (TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] S).toRingHom qK = q
